spec_features.evidence: agent_harness.py:122 `for turn_num in range(1, max_turns + 1):` bounds the interaction loop; when exhausted the loop ends and run_task returns (agent_harness.py:172-174). max_turns is supplied as 20 from config.py:71/96 (max_turns=20 / max_turns_per_run=20) and passed through experiment.py:101 -> harness.run_task(max_turns=...). The cap actually bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end. There is also a `if not tool_calls: break` at agent_harness.py:169 (early natural termination), but the 20-turn ceiling itself is the enforced hard stop.
